;---------- More Hate Triggers ------------
;------------------------------------------
Trigger More_Fear_Roman
	WhenToTest CharacterTurnEnd

	Condition IsGeneral
		  and RandomPercent < 10
		  and DiplomaticStanceFromCharacter romans_julii = AtWar
		  and Trait Brave < 2
		  and not FactionType roman_rebels_1
		  and not FactionType roman_rebels_2
		and ( Trait BadGeneral > 1
			or Trait BadCommander > 1
			or Trait BadDefender > 1
			or Trait BadDisciplinarian > 1
			or Trait Coward > 1
			or Trait BadAttacker > 1
			or Trait AnxiousGeneral > 0
			or Trait BadRaider > 1
			or Trait GeneralExperience < 3
		)

	Affects FearsRoman  1  Chance  1

;------------------------------------------
Trigger More_Hate_Roman
	WhenToTest CharacterTurnEnd

	Condition IsGeneral
		  and RandomPercent < 10
		  and DiplomaticStanceFromCharacter romans_julii = AtWar
		  and not FactionType roman_rebels_1
		  and not FactionType roman_rebels_2
		and ( Trait GoodGeneral > 1
			or Trait StrategicSkill > 1
			or Trait GoodRiskyAttacker > 1
			or Trait Disciplinarian > 1
			or Trait GoodCommander > 2
			or Trait Over_Confidence > 1
			or Trait Brave > 1
			or Trait GoodRaider > 1
			or Trait GeneralExperience > 4
		)

	Affects HatesRoman  1  Chance  1

  WhenToTest PostBattle

  Condition AgentType = admiral
		and CharacterIsLocal
		and FactionType carthage
		and Trait Captured_Flagship < 1
		and Trait Captured_Ships < 1
		and Trait Sailor > 0
		and WonBattle
		and I_ConflictType Naval
		and PercentageEnemyKilled > 20

  Affects Captured_Ships  1  Chance  25

Trigger class_assignment_trigger_for_any_generals_1
	WhenToTest CharacterTurnStart

	Condition IsGeneral
		  and ( FactionType romans_julii
			or FactionType roman_rebels_1
			or FactionType roman_rebels_2
		  )
		and Trait Plebeian = 0
		and Trait Equestrian = 0
		and Trait Patrician = 0

	Affects Plebeian 1 Chance 25
	Affects Equestrian 2 Chance 25
	Affects Patrician 3 Chance 10

;------------------------------------------

		and IsFactionLeader

	Affects Imperator  10  Chance  100
	Affects Princeps_Senatus  10  Chance  100

Trigger Imperator_granted_Low_Odds1
	WhenToTest PostBattle

	Condition IsGeneral
		and WonBattle
		and BattleOdds < 0.7
		and BattleSuccess >= close
		  and ( FactionType romans_julii
			or FactionType roman_rebels_1
			or FactionType roman_rebels_2
		  )
        and not TargetFactionType slave
        and WasAttacker
        and Trait Denied_Triumph = 1
        and Trait CelebratedTriumphator < 5

	Affects Imperator_Triumph  2  Chance  100

;------------------------------------------
Trigger Imperator_granted_Low_Odds2
	WhenToTest PostBattle

	Condition IsGeneral
		and WonBattle
		and BattleOdds < 0.7
		and BattleSuccess >= close
		  and ( FactionType romans_julii
			or FactionType roman_rebels_1
			or FactionType roman_rebels_2
		  )
        and not TargetFactionType slave
        and WasAttacker
        and Trait Imperator_Triumph < 1
        and Trait CelebratedTriumphator < 5

	Affects Imperator_Triumph  1  Chance  100

	WhenToTest CharacterTurnEnd

	Condition Trait GoodAdministrator > 1
		  and CultureType greek
		  and Trait Selflessness > 4
		  and Trait Generous >= 2
		  and Trait Wealthy > 0
		  and Trait Patron < 2
		  and Trait AttunedGovernor > 0
		  and RandomPercent < 10

	Affects Patron  1  Chance  1
	Affects BadCavalryGeneral  1  Chance  1

		  and Trait Temperament < 3

			  or FactionType bactria

		  and RandomPercent < 40

	Affects IntolerantOfOtherGods  1  Chance  1

  WhenToTest CharacterTurnEndInSettlement

  Condition Trait NaturalCharisma > 3
		and Trait NaturalIntelligence < 5
		and Trait NaturalEnergy > 2
		and Trait Handsome > 1
		and Trait Scandalous_Romantic < 1
		and Trait Upright < 1
		and Trait Girls > 1
		and Trait Roman_Scandal < 1
		  and ( FactionType romans_julii
			or FactionType roman_rebels_1
			or FactionType roman_rebels_2
		  )

  Affects Roman_Scandal  1  Chance  1

;Mission Triggers for Returning Alexandros to Pella
;===============================================================
;------------------------------------------
Trigger SeleukidGeneralConqueredAlexandreia
  WhenToTest GeneralCaptureSettlement

	Condition IsGeneral
		  and SettlementName Alexandria
		  and FactionType seleucid
		  and Trait SeleukidAlexanderTombMission < 1
		  and Trait SeleukidAlexandrosReturned < 1

  Affects SeleukidAlexanderTombMission  1  Chance  100

;------------------------------------------
Trigger MakedonianGeneralConqueredAlexandreia
  WhenToTest GeneralCaptureSettlement

	Condition IsGeneral
		  and SettlementName Alexandria
		  and FactionType antigonid
		  and Trait MakedonianAlexanderTombMission < 1
		  and Trait MakedonianAlexandrosReturned < 1

  Affects MakedonianAlexanderTombMission  1  Chance  100

;------------------------------------------
Trigger Seleukid_General_Returns_Alexander_to_Pella1
  WhenToTest CharacterTurnEndInSettlement

	Condition Trait SeleukidAlexanderTombMission = 1
		  and SettlementName Pella

  Affects SeleukidAlexandrosReturned  2  Chance  100

;------------------------------------------
Trigger Seleukid_General_Returns_Alexander_to_Pella2
  WhenToTest CharacterTurnEndInSettlement

	Condition Trait SeleukidAlexanderTombMission = 1
          and DiplomaticStanceFromCharacter antigonid = Allied

  Affects SeleukidAlexandrosReturned  2  Chance  100

;------------------------------------------
Trigger Makedonian_General_Returns_Alexander_to_Pella
  WhenToTest CharacterTurnEndInSettlement

	Condition Trait MakedonianAlexanderTombMission = 1
		  and SettlementName Pella

  Affects MakedonianAlexandrosReturned  2  Chance  100

Trigger capturing_enemy_camp1
	WhenToTest PostBattle

	Condition IsGeneral
		  and WasAttacker
		  and WonBattle
		  and PercentageEnemyKilled > 40

	Affects EnemyCampCaptured  1  Chance  100
	Affects EnemyCampCaptured  1  Chance  45

;------------------------------------------
Trigger capturing_enemy_camp2
	WhenToTest PostBattle

	Condition IsGeneral
		  and not WasAttacker
		  and WonBattle
		  and PercentageEnemyKilled > 40

	Affects DefCampCaptured  1  Chance  100
	Affects DefCampCaptured  1  Chance  45

;------------------------------------------
Trigger AMe_Anti_Manager
	WhenToTest CharacterTurnEnd

	Condition Trait SpoilsManager > 0

   Affects AntiManager  1  Chance  1
   Affects Just  1  Chance  5

;------------------------------------------
Trigger ASe_Anti_Scrooge
	WhenToTest CharacterTurnEnd

	Condition Trait SpoilsScrooge > 0
		and Trait Humble < 1

   Affects AntiScrooge  1  Chance  1
   Affects BadGeneral  1  Chance  10
   Affects Corrupt  1  Chance  5
   Affects Greed  1  Chance  5
   Affects Unjust  1  Chance  5

	WhenToTest CharacterTurnEnd

	Condition Trait SpoilsPopular > 0

   Affects AntiPopular  1  Chance  1
   Affects Just  1  Chance  10
   Affects Prim  1  Chance  10
   Affects Upright  1  Chance  5
   Affects Generous  1  Chance  10
   Affects Meritocratic  1  Chance  5

	WhenToTest CharacterTurnEnd

	Condition Trait SpoilsPopulist > 0

   Affects AntiPopulist  1  Chance  1
   Affects BadGeneral  1  Chance  5
   Affects Corrupt  1  Chance  5
   Affects Greed  1  Chance  5
   Affects Favoritism  1  Chance  5

  WhenToTest PostBattle

  Condition IsGeneral
		and Trait Supplies < 7
		and Trait EnemyCampCaptured > 0

  Affects Supplies  1  Chance  100
  Affects Supplies  1  Chance  75
  Affects Supplies  1  Chance  50

  WhenToTest PostBattle

  Condition IsGeneral
		and Trait Supplies < 7
		and Trait DefCampCaptured > 0

  Affects Supplies  1  Chance  100
  Affects Supplies  1  Chance  75
  Affects Supplies  1  Chance  50

		  and Trait Distracted > 0
		  and InEnemyLands

		  and Trait Uses_Watchwords_Cart < 1
		  and Trait Weak_Watchwords_Cart < 1
		  and Trait Strong_Watchwords_Cart < 1
